node.statement: Let A=Phi_n(Phi_n(Delta_n X)Phi_n(Delta_n Y)), B=Phi_n(Delta_n Z), C=Phi_n(Delta_n X Delta_n Y), and D=Delta_n Z, so P2=Phi_n(AB) and P3=Phi_n(CD). Contractivity of the outer Phi_n and AB-CD=(A-C)B+C(B-D) give ||P2-P3||<=||A-C||||B||+||C||||B-D||. The exact two-factor telescope Phi_n(Delta_n X)Phi_n(Delta_n Y)-Delta_n X Delta_n Y=[Phi_n(Delta_n X)-Delta_n X]Phi_n(Delta_n Y)+Delta_n X[Phi_n(Delta_n Y)-Delta_n Y], followed by contractivity, gives ||A-C||<=2d||X||||Y||. Also ||B||<=||Z||, ||C||<=||X||||Y||, and ||B-D||<=d||Z||. Thus ||P2-P3||<=3d||X||||Y||||Z||.
